title: Expiry, Dormancy and Reinstatement Terms by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
These are the terms of the Wanderlane Traveller Club governing how long points live and on what terms lapsed points may be brought back. The expiry term is the number of calendar months after which unused spendable points lapse. Extension on activity records whether any qualifying activity resets the expiry clock on the whole balance. The inactivity term is the number of calendar months of complete inactivity after which the membership itself lapses. The reinstatement fee is charged in US dollars to reinstate points that have already lapsed, and the reinstatement window is the number of calendar days after lapse within which points may still be reinstated.

## Terms by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Expiry term (calendar months) | 18 | 24 | 24 | 36 | 36 | 48 |
| Extension on activity | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Inactivity term (calendar months) | 24 | 24 | 30 | 36 | 36 | 48 |
| Reinstatement fee (USD) | 150 | 125 | 95 | 75 | 0 | 0 |
| Reinstatement window (calendar days) | 0 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 180 | 365 |

## Reading of the terms

Wanderlane Blue is the one tier at which the expiry clock does not extend with activity, and the one tier at which the reinstatement window stands at 0 calendar days. The window then widens tier by tier, from 30 days at Wanderlane Silver to 365 days at Wanderlane Ambassador, while the reinstatement fee falls in the same direction, from 150 at Wanderlane Blue to 0 at Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador.

The expiry term and the inactivity term are separate figures that stand at the same number of calendar months at some tiers and not at others. They agree at Wanderlane Silver, at 24 calendar months each, at Wanderlane Platinum and Wanderlane Titanium, at 36 each, and at Wanderlane Ambassador, at 48 each. They differ at Wanderlane Blue, where an expiry term of 18 calendar months runs against an inactivity term of 24, and at Wanderlane Gold, where an expiry term of 24 runs against an inactivity term of 30.
